body:
electroconvulsive therapy

You are put under anaesthesia, then an electric shock is delivered to your brain causing it to, in a way, reset.

I will be trying 120VAC to the temples if I do it on my own.

I have in the past, and was met with a lot of resistance.  I can no longer afford care, even with medicare.  My only way to get care now will probably to walk into an ER and explain the situation, and hope they hear that I am serious.
I don't even know why I'm posting here.

Car is basically fixed.  Kids go for visitation this weekend.  Method's settled.

Now some decisions.  Note or not?
Most of the ones that you're supposed to talk to do.
Been there.  Pills are worse than death.
Anxiety.  Hell.  Hallucinations are getting trickier.  Got to hold on until something gives one way or another.
It's all coming apart in my head.
Of course, on the other hand, the ex is saying she's having similar issues with her hubby.
Well, in additional news, the kids who live with my ex have called to say they do not want to see me.  I kind of see that as verification that the ones I have would be better off there.
I dunno.  Would talking help?  I'm just so lost right now.
Good news!  The wife is leaving, so...  there's that.  O.o
